label: mempalace CLI
summary: Persistent project memory: sessions wake up with context and file their work back, scoped to one wing per project.
why: Local, no API key. The four memory hooks (SessionStart, Stop, PreCompact, SessionEnd) are silent no-ops without this CLI.

install.note: Isolated tool venv. Never plain pip: Homebrew's Python is externally managed (PEP 668).

afterInstall: run 'mempalace mcp' to wire the MCP server

verify.failsOn: The CLI is missing or its venv is broken.

uninstall: pipx uninstall mempalace || uv tool uninstall mempalace

drifts: the package name mempalace on PyPI
